mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the source or ground of the being of all individual beings and it manifests itself in them (Heidegger, 1962a: 231)."
Being itself is the source or ground of the being of all individual beings and it manifests itself in them (Heidegger, 1962a: 231).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a philosophical system whose founder is Confucius and its doctrine is founded on the cultivation of virtues and human development."
Chinese Confucianism is a philosophical system whose founder is Confucius and its doctrine is founded on the cultivation of virtues and human development.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the structural unity between thought and intuition; that is the unity between the intellect [thought] and intuition."
Transcendence is the structural unity between thought and intuition; that is the unity between the intellect [thought] and intuition.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered as a fundamental component of human being."
Freedom is considered as a fundamental component of human being.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a basic human trait which you find in every human, even in the dumb."
Language too is a basic human trait which you find in every human, even in the dumb.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the process of thesis, anti-thesis and synthesis (Stumpf;1979)."
Dialectics originally refers to the process of thesis, anti-thesis and synthesis (Stumpf;1979).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a causi sui; that whose essence necessarily involves existence (Ibid)."
The absolute is a causi sui; that whose essence necessarily involves existence (Ibid).
